Maya: Quick sync 1: summit booth run-through tonight. Need final owner for AV/mic, lead-scan flow, volunteer shifts, and swag staging. Who can do 5pm load-in? @Jordan?

Sophia: Panel timing 6:10-6:40pm. Need lav + stand mic. Who's doing mic check at 5:45?

Jordan: POD uploaded: https://files.redwood/shipments/RWD-SMT-07. Will attach final when courier confirms.
Ava-Bot: Swag status update: totes shipped, stickers delivered, hoodies ETA 3:20pm. Tracking 1Z8888YY.
Maya: Routing rules for leads -> growth: VIP = immediate Slack DM to @Jordan + crm tag "vip-lead"; Demo = schedule with demos team within 48h; Nurture = add to marketing drip. Need CSV field names to be exact.
Liam: CSV header: name,email,company,title,tag,notes,source,qr_id. Example export: `leadscan export --format csv --fields name,email,company,title,tag,notes,source,qr_id > summit_leads_1741203456.csv`
Jordan: I'll SFTP export to growth@redwood:/incoming/summit/ after the event and ping #growth with filename.
Sophia: Signage note: keep ADA clear path and confirm power strip placement. Need a 10ft extension for laptop station.
Devin: I'll bring extension, labeled adapters (US/EU/UK), battery pack, and spare hotspot.
Maya: Roles: Jordan = courier & POD; Liam = lead capture pipeline; Devin = swag staging & kit; Sophia = speaker escort & mic check; I'll coordinate volunteer rotations.
Jordan: On my way to dock now, will post crate photo.
Liam: Signup link posted in #volunteers: https://slack.redwood/archives/volunteers/p23456. Please add availability.
Maya: Post-show follow-up: marketing to send a 24hr "thanks for stopping by" email with link to benchmark sign-up. Trigger by tag mapping.
Sophia: I'll draft VIP + General email variants and share by EOD.
Devin: Leaving office at 3:45pm to pick up crates and head to venue.
Maya: Thanks team 1: see you at load-in. :rocket:
